post_json.doc:
Make an HTTP POST request with JSON `Accept` and `Content-Type` headers.

Arguments:
	url (str): Target URL.
	body (str|bytes|nil): JSON-encoded request body (e.g. via `json_dump(...)`).
	options (thing|nil): Optional extra settings such as `headers` or `params`.

Example:
	requests.post_json('https://example.org', json_dump({key: 'value'}));

req.doc:
Make a custom HTTP request.

Arguments:
	url (str): Target URL.
	options (thing|nil): Optional settings such as `method` (defaults to `GET`), `params`, `headers`, and `body`.

Example:
	requests.req('https://example.org', {
		method: 'POST',
		params: [['arg', '123']],
		headers: [['Content-Type', 'application/json']],
		body: json_dump(data)
	});
